menu.label: Chat actions
menu.rename.desc: Give this chat a name of your own
menu.export.desc: Save this chat as a Markdown file
menu.nothing: There is nothing to export yet
menu.noComputer: This chat's computer is not shown in the top bar
menu.noChat: This menu is for chats with an agent
rename.title: Rename chat
rename.label: Chat name
rename.help: Leave it empty to use the automatic title.
rename.gone: This chat no longer exists on its computer.
rename.refused: The agent did not rename the chat.
rename.bad: The agent did not accept that name.
rename.busy: A close, delete or trim of this chat is still waiting. Settle it first.
rename.dismissWarn: Check again first. Stop tracking only if you know it did not go through.
export.cut: {{count}} characters of this message are not included.
export.cut_one: {{count}} character of this message is not included.
menu.compact.desc: Summarise the earlier messages to free up room
menu.close.desc: Stop it on its computer; it stays in your list
menu.readOnly: This chat is open for reading only
compact.parked: Compact was not sent. Answer the waiting approval first.
compact.unknown: Compact may not have been sent. Check this chat's recent actions.
close.title: Close this chat?
close.body: Running work stops and any waiting approval ends. The chat stays in your list and can be opened again.
close.loops.unknown: Its loops stop too if it has any.
close.gone: This chat is not available on its computer.
close.refused: The agent did not close the chat.
close.open: This chat is still open. Try closing it again.
close.busy: A rename, delete or trim of this chat is still waiting. Settle it first.
menu.delete.desc: Remove it and its history for good
delete.title: Delete this chat?
delete.body: This removes the chat and its history for good. Anything running in it stops.
delete.live: Still open somewhere else. Close it there, then press Delete chat again.
delete.missing: This chat could not be found for you. Nothing was deleted.
delete.absent: This chat could not be found for you any more. It may have been deleted.
delete.there: This chat is still there. Nothing was deleted.
delete.refused: The agent did not delete the chat.
delete.busy: A rename, close or trim of this chat is still waiting. Settle it first.
